{{Quote|I have the exact locations of both the clone DNA room and the clone trooper barracks.|Asajj Ventress to General Grievous prior to their assault on Tipoca City|<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''clone DNA room''' was where the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] samples of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] were stored by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched an [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|assault]] on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] with the aid of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. After both Ventress and Grievous landed on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and infiltrated the city, they parted ways&mdash;Grievous to kill as many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as possible in the barracks, and Ventress to steal a sample of Jango Fett's DNA for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] own purposes.

Ventress made her way to the DNA room unhindered and retrieved a sample of Fett's DNA. As she prepared to leave, she was confronted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The pair [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] briefly in the chamber before moving into the corridor outside. Ventress nearly escaped with the genetic material but was ultimately thwarted in her mission by Skywalker with the assistance of clone troopers.
